drhp.business: KCP manufactures and markets cement (90.16% of turnover) from plants in Andhra Pradesh, alongside a Heavy Engineering unit making machinery/castings at Thiruvottiyur (Chennai) and a hospitality business operating the Mercure Hyderabad KCP hotel. Through subsidiary KCP Vietnam Industries Limited it also runs sugar-cane crushing, sugar production and captive power generation in Vietnam, and holds a 40% joint-venture stake in Fives Cail KCP Limited, a sugar-machinery/boiler manufacturer.

risks.note: Cement Division's FY2026-27 performance is stated to largely depend on coal prices softening; global coal prices rose through FY26 (to USD 120-125/MT from USD 85-90/MT) on geopolitical disruptions (Middle East, Suez Canal, US-Iran conflict), and the late-FY26 spike in coal and packing-bag prices already hurt Q4 cement profits.

Aggressive consolidation and national players chasing volumes in the south Indian market impacted price realisation in KCP's core southern markets during FY23-25, and continued regional competition is flagged as a factor determining Cement Division margins in FY2026-27.

Competition from the unorganised sector kept Heavy Engineering margins under structural pressure, driving the segment to a negative EBIT in FY26 (Rs -4.66 crore) versus a small positive EBIT in FY25 (Rs 2.44 crore); management flags this pressure as continuing.
risks.risk: Heavy Engineering margin pressure from unorganised-sector competition

risks.note: Continuing geopolitical disruptions (Israel-Palestine conflict, Russia-Ukraine war, US-Iran tensions) kept commodity and logistics costs buoyant, while the Rupee depreciated from Rs 85.60 to Rs 94.65/USD over FY26, raising the landed cost of imported raw materials for the Company's manufacturing businesses.

KCP Vietnam Industries Limited's PBT fell 25.9% YoY (to Rs 235.93 crore from Rs 318.47 crore) as average sugar sales realisation dropped ~13% in line with international sugar prices while cane/raw-material costs rose, showing the subsidiary's earnings are structurally exposed to global sugar price and input-cost cycles.
risks.risk: Overseas sugar subsidiary exposure to price/cost cycles

risks.note: The Government of India's ban on sugar exports is expected to push sugar mills toward ethanol blending instead of incinerator-based juice processing, shrinking the addressable market for the JV's boiler/incinerator products; both the domestic and international (Africa) sugar-machinery markets are described as being in a downward trend, and the JV's order backlog fell from INR 98.7 crore to INR 81.6 crore over the year.
risks.risk: Structural demand risk for the sugar-machinery JV (Fives Cail KCP)

risks.note: Management notes that although the Mercure Hyderabad KCP hotel continues to improve occupancy and ARR, its revenue and bottom line will be affected by the general economic situation in India, making the segment sensitive to macro cyclicality.

The Railway Siding project at Muktyala, originally targeted for completion by end of FY2025-26, was delayed to the first half of FY2026-27 due to contractor manpower shortage and untimely excessive rainfall, illustrating execution risk on the Company's named capex projects.
